tasks.location: Between D5 and F5, under tank 117
tasks.description: Roll the solenoid valve so the coil is facing away from the steam line.
1/2 inch PVC line is very out of level and has a lot of downward tension on it. It needs repair.
Unnecessary piece of unistrut to be removed. Count: 5 (one under each tank). The ones under tanks 114, 119, 106 and 103 are about 8 in long. The one below tank 223 is small and has sharp edges.
Steam trap and condensate line are much too close to both the conduit and the Alkaline Acid waste line.
Conduit cover needs to be secured. It is missing the screw.
At least 40 pieces of unistrut are laying on bottom beam flanges and are not secured to the beams. Clamps are on order. When they arrive, install one clamp on each piece to secure it.
Air agitation line needs to be leveled (circled in photo).
Install a piece of strut to support the conduit that supplies the solenoid valve.
The junction box cover hanging from the box is the wrong size. It is too small.
LB tee fitting has a green ground wire and a white common wire hanging out of it that are not connected to anything. They prevent the cover from closing.
LB electrical cover is missing (circled in photo).
